title: Pods in Depth
summary: The smallest deployable unit: pod spec, lifecycle and container states, restart policies, init and sidecar containers, the downward API, graceful shutdown, static pods and ephemeral debug containers.
objectives: Read and write a complete pod spec, including command/args, env, resources, probes and volumes
Explain pod phases, pod conditions and container states, and interpret STATUS values and exit codes
Choose the right restartPolicy and understand CrashLoopBackOff
Use init containers and native sidecar containers, and recognise ambassador and adapter patterns
Share data and the network namespace between containers in a pod
Expose pod metadata to containers with the downward API
Implement graceful termination for a Node.js service with SIGTERM handling, preStop and terminationGracePeriodSeconds
Debug minimal images with ephemeral containers via `kubectl debug`
